title: Your whole account, and a game database
summary: The inventory now holds characters, weapons and artifacts, GOOD files go both ways, and every character, weapon, artifact set and material has a page to browse.

changes.text: Import a GOOD file from Genshin Optimizer, Inventory Kamera or any other tool. Choose which parts to bring in: characters, weapons, artifacts or materials.

The inventory has a page for each part of your account: Materials, Characters, Weapons and Artifacts (/inventory/weapons and so on), each with its own search and filters. The header and the links between them stay put while you switch.
Characters show their level, constellation and talents. Weapons show their level, refinement and who holds them. Artifacts show their set, main stat, substats and who wears them.

Characters, Weapons and Artifact Sets pages: every playable character by element, weapon and region; every weapon with its max-level ATK, substat and passive; every artifact set with its pieces and set bonuses. The ones in your inventory are marked.
The Materials page lists the bag's Materials tab too: local specialties, cooking ingredients, fish and bait, ores, wood and crafting materials, each with its own filter.
The game database lives under /db: Materials, Characters, Weapons and Artifacts, linked to each other and from the top bar's new Database link. Old /materials links still work.
Export .GOOD saves everything in your inventory, so you can import your account, update materials with a scan and export one complete file.
Imported local specialties, ingredients and other Materials-tab items show in your inventory with their icons, and anything newer than our data is kept and exported.
Characters, weapons and sets released after our game data still import and export, shown by name without an icon.
The Materials and Inventory pages download about a third less: material descriptions now load only when you search or open a material, and each inventory page only loads what it shows.
Filter rows that scroll sideways on phones no longer show a scrollbar under them.
